items.title: Sanofi reportedly weighing a buyout of Insmed, developer of respiratory drug Brinsupri
items.summary: Fierce Pharma, citing Bloomberg, reports Sanofi may be considering acquiring Insmed as it faces the Dupixent patent cliff. Report only, unconfirmed by either company.

items.title: GE HealthCare adds Lung Guidance and AutoAS artificial intelligence tools to Vscan Air SL handheld ultrasound
items.summary: GE HealthCare announced two features for the Vscan Air SL on 03/11/2026: Lung Guidance (probe guidance across the eight-zone lung protocol, with B-line detection and scoring) and AutoAS (a diagnostic aid flagging possible moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from at least two views).

items.title: Improve vaccine access for people with lung conditions, taskforce concludes
items.summary: Too many people with lung conditions are missing out on vital vaccines, according to a taskforce calling for better education and easier access. A survey of more than 2,200 adults with lung conditions commissioned by the Taskforce for Lung Health found many did not see themselves at risk.

items.title: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust — Neighbourhood COPD Risk Stratification Population Health Project (C491927)
items.summary: This project aims to develop and implement a specialist-led, integrated neighbourhood model of care for people living with COPD across Hull and East Yorkshire.

items.title: Vaping could increase risk of COPD, preliminary research suggests
items.summary: Vaping several times a day may cause persistent changes in lung function in young people putting them at increased risk of a chronic and life-limiting lung condition, a new study has suggested.
